title: Fungal DNA Extraction for Nanopore Sequencing
author: Eri Ogiso-Tanaka
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2vfqe3n

steps.title: Grind frozen mycelium
steps.instruction: Place frozen mycelium in liquid nitrogen and grind with a mortar and pestle to a fine powder, keeping the sample cold.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and enzymes
steps.instruction: Transfer the powder to a glass beaker and add 20 mL pre‑warmed (60 °C) lysis buffer (2 % CTAB, 100 mM Tris‑HCl, 20 mM EDTA, 1.4 M NaCl, 1 % PVP) together with 800 µL Proteinase K (FUJIFILM Wako) and 50 µL RNase A (Nippon Gene). Mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in a water bath at 55 °C with shaking for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1 vol) of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) to the lysate and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCI mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm (≈13,000 × g) using a soft/slow brake for 20 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Repeat PCI extraction
steps.instruction: Add another 1 vol of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol, invert to mix, centrifuge as in step 5, and transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol chloroform, invert to mix (perform in a fume hood), then centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (≈17,800 × g) with a soft/slow brake for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect chloroform phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Repeat chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add another 1 vol chloroform, invert, centrifuge as in step 8, and transfer the aqueous layer to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol isopropanol to the aqueous solution and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (≈17,800 × g) for 5 minutes at 4 °C, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the pellet (and any residual liquid) to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, spin briefly, and remove any remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Rinse the pellet with 1 mL 75 % ethanol at room temperature.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet until the ethanol odor disappears (you can smell to confirm).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA in 50 µL sterile 10 mM Tris‑HCl, incubate ~1 hour at room temperature in the dark (or up to overnight). Do not vortex or pipet; gently flick the tube to aid dissolution.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at 4 °C for short‑term use or at –20 °C for long‑term storage until library preparation.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer and a Qubit 2.0 fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity
steps.instruction: Evaluate DNA degradation using the Genomic DNA ScreenTape assay on an Agilent 2200 TapeStation system (Agilent Technologies).
